summary.text: Lynn Dickinson, listed by Ballotpedia as Eileen Dickinson, is a Republican state representative from Franklin-2 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Pam McCarthy.
She is a farmer and former realtor.

paragraphs.text: Lynn Dickinson graduated from John F. Kennedy High School in Katonah, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from Manhattanville College in 1971.
Her career experience includes owning a farm and working as a realtor with Poquette & Bruley.

Dickinson has served on the Community College of Vermont in Franklin County advisory board, the Franklin-Grand Isle mental health agency board, and a public oversight commission for the Vermont Department of Banking, Insurance, Securities & Health Care Administration.
She chaired the Vermont State College Board and served as a legislative trustee, and she served on the board of trustees of Bellows Free Academy in St. Albans, including as chair.
Dickinson has served in the Vermont House since 2009, and her committee assignments have included Commerce and Economic Development in most sessions, including 2023-2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
